question: ports scalerank<=6 inside lon 5..32 lat 55..71: geojson + lon/lat 4dp
sql: SELECT p.name, p.scalerank, ST_AsGeoJSON(p.geometry) AS point_geojson, ROUND(ST_X(p.geometry), 4) AS lon, ROUND(ST_Y(p.geometry), 4) AS lat FROM ports p WHERE p.scalerank <= 6 AND ST_X(p.geometry) BETWEEN 5 AND 32 AND ST_Y(p.geometry) BETWEEN 55 AND 71 ORDER BY p.name, lon, lat

question: Vatican boundary as WKT + area km2 3dp
sql: SELECT c.name, ST_AsText(c.geometry) AS boundary_wkt, ROUND(ST_Area_Spheroid(c.geometry) / 1000000.0, 3) AS area_km2 FROM countries c WHERE c.name = 'Vatican'

question: ports with website, one line each: 'name | site | lon, lat' coords 4dp, a-z
sql: SELECT printf('%s | %s | %.4f, %.4f', p.name, p.website, ST_X(p.geometry), ST_Y(p.geometry)) AS port_line FROM ports p WHERE p.website IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.name, ST_X(p.geometry), ST_Y(p.geometry)

question: nearest port to (-74.11, 40.66): name, coords 4dp, km 2dp
sql: SELECT p.name AS port, ROUND(ST_X(p.geometry), 4) AS lon, ROUND(ST_Y(p.geometry), 4) AS lat, ROUND(ST_Distance_Spheroid(p.geometry, ST_Point(-74.11, 40.66)) / 1000.0, 2) AS km FROM ports p ORDER BY ST_Distance_Spheroid(p.geometry, ST_Point(-74.11, 40.66)) ASC, p.name ASC LIMIT 1

question: top 5 countries by population: name, pop in millions 1dp, centroid geojson
sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(c.pop_est / 1000000.0, 1) AS pop_millions, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Centroid(c.geometry)) AS centroid_geojson FROM countries c ORDER BY c.pop_est DESC, c.name ASC LIMIT 5

question: Caribbean: count, ';'-joined country names a-z, bbox as geojson
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_countries, string_agg(c.name, '; ' ORDER BY c.name) AS country_list, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Extent_Agg(c.geometry)) AS bbox_geojson FROM countries c WHERE c.subregion = 'Caribbean'
